exe.description:
Internal driver used by SoundBlaster speech synthesis.
Speech engine calls into this code to play sound via the SoundBlaster hardware.

functions.name: driver_entry_write_sample
functions.desc: Driver jump table entry: write audio sample to playback buffer

functions.name: driver_entry_init
functions.desc: Driver jump table entry: initialize Sound Blaster driver

functions.name: driver_entry_flush_and_wait
functions.desc: Driver jump table entry: flush audio buffer and wait for playback to finish

functions.name: driver_entry_get_active_buffer_offset
functions.desc: Driver jump table entry: get active audio buffer offset

functions.name: driver_entry_noop
functions.desc: Driver jump table entry: no-op / stub entry point

functions.name: dsp_write_byte_blocking
functions.desc: Writes a command or data byte to the DSP write-buffer port (polling without timeout)

functions.name: dma_setup_transfer
functions.desc: Program 8237 DMA controller for 8-bit sound transfer

functions.name: seg_offset_to_linear_20bit
functions.desc: Converts segment:offset address (DX:AX) to 20-bit linear physical address (DX:AX)

functions.name: hook_irq_vector
functions.desc: Hook an IRQ interrupt vector (IRQ 0-7 / INT 08h-0Fh) and save the previous handler

functions.name: sb_start_dma_playback_block
functions.desc: Programs the DMA controller and Sound Blaster DSP to start playing the next audio block

functions.name: sb_play_sound_buffer
functions.desc: Start playing an audio buffer via Sound Blaster DMA

functions.name: sb_switch_and_flush_buffer
functions.desc: Flush/start playback of the current audio buffer and switch to the alternate ping-pong buffer

functions.name: sb_write_sample
functions.desc: Append an audio sample byte to the current Sound Blaster playback buffer

functions.name: sb_get_active_buffer_offset
functions.desc: Get base offset of the currently active audio buffer

functions.name: sb_noop_stub
functions.desc: No-op far return stub

functions.name: sb_driver_init
functions.desc: Initialize the Sound Blaster driver and hook interrupt 0xF3

functions.name: sb_flush_and_wait
functions.desc: Flush audio buffer and wait for Sound Blaster playback completion

functions.name: apply_echo_sample
functions.desc: Apply echo/delay effect to an 8-bit PCM audio sample

functions.name: parse_blaster_env
functions.desc: Parse the BLASTER environment variable for Sound Blaster configuration (port, IRQ, DMA)

functions.name: memchr
functions.desc: Searches a buffer for the first occurrence of a byte

functions.name: memcmp_exact
functions.desc: Compare memory buffer against a string for equality
